note: Each case gives a world (and events or ops) and what a correct implementation must produce. Geometry hashes are over coordinates rounded to six decimals. Nothing here depends on trigonometry, so results are comparable across languages.

cases.name: seed-world
cases.note: The world the workshop starts from: structure, validity and every tile’s content hash.

cases.name: signals-and-state
cases.note: A signal travelling the graph, and closed-form state after six offline hours.

cases.name: depth-collapse
cases.note: Collapsing tiles into one and expanding again must be exactly reversible, state included.

cases.name: recipe-shapes
cases.note: Shapes described as matter: the geometry a recipe must produce, point for point.

cases.name: composed-and-painted
cases.note: A shape made of another shape, at two settings, painted by position and by surface direction.

cases.name: sleeping-capability
cases.note: A capability asleep in a node costs nothing; waking it changes state, never matter.

cases.name: text-round-trip
cases.note: Writing a world out as text and reading it back must change nothing.
